about: A chat eval case (#581), kept as a scripted fixture: the offline eval (vouch.evals) scores assessments, not chat. A chat eval would run each case here through the chat agent on a model and score the tool it called and the controls its answer cites. tests/test_chat_rounds.py checks the case against the tool on the fake, offline.
question: What improved since Q2 2026?
rounds: First round closed; Q2 2026 closed with 1.1.1 accepted partly evidenced and 1.6.1 accepted evidenced; Q3 2026 open; nothing accepted now.
